title: Starlight Fishing Rod
text: Each successful catch has a 20% chance to bring in one extra Stardust. Hooking an entity and reeling it in each count as a rod attack. Creatures struck by the rod glow for 30 seconds.

The line reaches up to 64 blocks. The float sparkles on the surface. While you wait, bright green grains tumble up through Decayed Timeflow and icy blue stars surface in Void Starflow. Ripples mark an approaching fish. Reel in when the float dips.
